desc:
🐒 Welcome to Be Monkey For Brainrots!

Train your monkey, increase your Jump Strength, and launch yourself higher and farther than ever before!

🏋️ Lift increasingly ridiculous weights
🚀 Jump across the map and reach new areas
💰 Earn Cash and purchase stronger upgrades
🧠 Discover and collect rare Brainrots
🍌 Progress from lifting a tiny Banana all the way to carrying Planets and Black Holes
🌈 Find secrets and become the strongest monkey in the world!

CONTROLS:
PC: Charge - Hold Shift
Mobile: Charge - Hold button
Console: Charge - Hold R2

❤️ Support the game by liking, favoriting, and joining the group for bonus rewards!
